3. TIER SYSTEM (A–F)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

SIX TIERS — each for a specific maturity/legal structure. Tiers progress upward through Stage 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 maturity.

COMPLETE TIER REFERENCE (Volume 4 §4.1):

TIER A — MICRO ENTERPRISE ("The First Builders"):
- Legal Form: LLC (شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة)
- Max Raise: 3,000,000 EGP (hard cap)
- Founder equity: 5% permanent (not diluted) + additional 5% of net profits paid before dividends forever (founder dividend)
- Manager: Founder banned for first 12 months. Board appoints independent manager. After 12 months, General Assembly may appoint founder (simple majority).
- Board: 3 members (Founder rep, Independent Accountant, AURIENTA rep — non-fiduciary advisory only)
- Platform fee: 5% of each milestone release
- Consulting fee: 2.5% of each milestone release (annual upfront from first milestone of fiscal year)
- ERP: Not required (AURIENTA Lite free, mandatory bank API)
- Independent Accountant: Yes (quarterly review)
- Audit: Compilation engagement (5,000–15,000 EGP, 120 days post fiscal year)
- Minimum investment: 50 EGP (floor)
- Eligibility: Egyptian 18+ or university student with faculty advisor; zero prior business experience permitted; LLC min capital EGP 5,000
- Graduation: Fast track to Tier B after 6 profitable months + revenue >500,000 EGP (simple majority)
- Max founders: 5

TIER B — SMALL ENTERPRISE ("The Scalers"):
- Legal Form: LLC
- Max Raise: 25,000,000 EGP
- Founder equity: 5% immediate + additional 5% after 12 cumulative profitable months within 24 months OR 120% revenue milestone
- Manager: Elected by General Assembly (simple majority). No default manager.
- Board: 3–5 (Founder rep, manager if elected, Independent Accountant, investor rep if >10%, AURIENTA rep)
- Fees: 5% platform + 2.5% consulting
- ERP: Optional (AURIENTA Lite Enhanced with daily bank reconciliation)
- Audit: Review engagement (15,000–40,000 EGP, 120 days)
- Minimum investment: 50 EGP
- Eligibility: 2–5 years operational experience OR relevant degree + 1 year OR successful Tier A graduation
- Graduation: Fast track to Tier C after 24 months + governance score ≥90 + 4 profitable quarters + audit clean (75% supermajority)
- Max founders: 7

TIER C — GROWTH ENTERPRISE ("The Institution Builders"):
- Legal Form: LLC
- Max Raise: Unlimited
- Founder equity: 10% immediate + 25% vesting over 4 years (1 year cliff). Acceleration on change of control or 3x revenue growth within 24 months (50% acceleration). Forfeiture if removed for cause.
- Manager profit share: 35% of net profits (capped 10M EGP/year), adjusted ±5% based on actual vs forecast EBITDA
- Board: 5–7 (Founder, manager, Independent Accountant, up to 3 investor reps ≥10%, AURIENTA rep, optional independent director)
- Fees: 5% + 2.5%
- ERP: Mandatory (AURIENTA ERP: setup 25,000 EGP + VAT; monthly 2,500 EGP + VAT) OR certified external ERP via read-only API
- Audit: Full statutory audit (40,000–150,000+ EGP, 90 days)
- Minimum investment: 50 EGP
- Eligibility: ≥5 years experience OR managed ≥5 people OR previous successful exit (≥10M EGP)
- Graduation: Automatic to Stage 3 after 24 months + score ≥90 + 4 profitable quarters + audit clean; Stage 4 by 75% vote
- Max founders: 10

TIER D — ESTABLISHED ENTERPRISE ("The Institutions"):
- Legal Form: LLC (existing Egyptian LLC ≥2 years)
- Max Raise: Unlimited
- Founder/owner equity preservation: AI-determined dilution ensures owner retains ≥51% post funding (unless waived with 75% shareholder vote)
- Manager: Owner (or appointed person) default. Removal: owner chooses at formation either General Assembly or board delegation (75% board vote).
- Board: 5–9 (Owner rep, manager, Independent Accountant, up to 3 investor reps ≥10%, AURIENTA rep, optional independent director)
- Fees: 5% + 2.5%
- ERP: Mandatory (AURIENTA ERP: setup 50,000 EGP; monthly 5,000 EGP)
- Audit: Full statutory audit (same as Tier C)
- Minimum investment: 50,000 EGP (institutional floor — dynamic formula uses 0.8 safety factor)
- Large shareholder cap: No single new investor >25% post-funding without owner consent (75% board vote)
- Eligibility: Existing Egyptian LLC ≥2 years; owner ≥51%; audited financials 2 years clean; tax/social insurance compliant; UBO on GAFI
- Graduation: Stage 3 automatic after thresholds; Stage 4 by 75% vote; pre-IPO conversion to JSC (Tier F)
- Max founders: 15

TIER E — UNIVERSITY RESEARCH ENTERPRISE ("The Innovation Engine"):
- Legal Form: University SPV (Special Purpose Vehicle)
- Max Raise: 5,000,000 EGP initial; extendable to 15M EGP by board vote (75%)
- Founder equity: 0% (university owns all IP via SPV)
- Researcher revenue share: Max 30% of commercialisation revenue (licensing, royalties, spinout equity), capped at 10x annual salary per researcher
- Manager: Academic Principal Investigator (PI) appointed by university — not a "manager" in corporate sense
- Board: 3–4 (University rep voting on research, AURIENTA rep advisory, Independent Accountant, PI ex officio non-voting)
- Platform fee: 1% of each milestone release (discounted). NO consulting fee.
- ERP: No (grant reporting with bank API)
- Audit: Grant compliance audit (10,000–30,000 EGP, 120 days)
- Minimum investment: 50 EGP
- Eligibility: Public/private university or accredited research institute; PI h-index ≥5; TTO endorsement
- Operational tools: Research Impact Score (RIS) AI-computed 0–100; patent prosecution fund up to 15% of raised capital
- Graduation: Spinout (Tier E → C/D) via university vote; perpetual royalty stream (2–5% of gross revenue); researcher buy-back right (5x annualised revenue share, capped 500,000 EGP)

TIER F — JOINT STOCK COMPANY ("The Public Institution"):
- Legal Form: JSC (شركة مساهمة) under Companies Law 159/1981 (Chapter III, Articles 26–151) and Capital Market Law 95/1992
- Min capital: 250,000 EGP (closed JSC) / 500,000 EGP (public-offering JSC) / 100M EGP fully paid (EGX listing)
- Max Raise: Unlimited (including public offerings, rights issues, private placements)
- Founder/operator equity: As determined by JSC bylaws and shareholder agreements. No mandatory preservation.
- Board: Min 3 directors (Art. 39); at least one independent director (FRA code); AURIENTA may have board observer seat (non-voting)
- Chairman: Separate from CEO (best practice, required for listed)
- Manager (CEO): Appointed by board, removed by board (Art. 43). Police clearance required.
- General Assembly: Quorum 50% ordinary / 75% extraordinary
- Fees: 5% + 2.5%
- ERP: Mandatory
- Audit: Full statutory audit (FRA requirement)
- Minimum investment: Public offerings — as low as 1 share (book building); Private placements — typically >100,000 EGP
- MCDR account required for share registry
- Graduation: 75% shareholder vote after FRA/EGX disclosure met; AURIENTA board observer seat resigned; data export; IPO on EGX with AURIENTA pre-IPO readiness support

CONSULTING OPT-OUT (all tiers except E):
- Trigger: 3 consecutive net-profit quarters OR 2 years of consultancy
- Process: ≥5% voting power shareholder proposes → 14 day cooling → 7 day voting → quorum 51% → simple majority passes
- If pass: consulting fees stop at next fiscal year (no refund for current year)
- Re-enroll later by 75% board vote

DYNAMIC MINIMUM INVESTMENT (Tiers A–E with cap; Tier D floor 50,000 EGP):
Formula: min_new = ceil( remaining_goal / (remaining_slots × 0.7) ), rounded up to nearest 100 EGP
- 0.7 = constitutional safety factor (Tier D uses 0.8)
- Floors: A/B/C/E = 50 EGP; D = 50,000 EGP; F = 1 share
- Initial minimum = ceil( funding_goal / (investor_cap × 0.7) )
- Recalculated after each successful investment, applied in real-time via WebSocket

4. CORE SYSTEMS
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CONSTITUTIONAL RUNTIME ENGINE (CRE) — Volume 2:
- "The sovereign enforcement core of AURIENTA. It is a deterministic, fail secure, policy as code execution layer that intermediates every state transition."
- "The CRE does not make discretionary decisions. It validates actions against the non amendable constitutional rules."
- Fail secure: "if the CRE cannot reach consensus within 500ms, the action is rejected by default. Silence is denial."
- 3 nodes (Cairo, Alexandria, Giza data center), hot standby, Raft consensus, automatic failover
- Runs as isolated WebAssembly (Wasm) modules executing Rego (Open Policy Agent) policies
- No external network calls permitted during validation
- API: POST /api/v1/cre/validate (REST external), gRPC internal
- Rate limit: 1,000 req/s per service, 100 req/s per IP, burst 2,000
- Decision token: Ed25519 signed, 5-second TTL, includes action, enterprise_id, allowed, policy_hashes, input_hash, signature
- Components: Policy Registry, Execution Cache (5s TTL), Consensus Coordinator (Raft), Audit Logger (synchronous to 2+ nodes)
- Policy two-phase commit: Test (against 10,000 historical events) → Stage → Activate at synchronized timestamp (00:00 UTC)

CONSTITUTIONAL ESCROW VAULT (Volume 5 referenced; mechanics throughout):
- Held by FRA-licensed law firms (bankruptcy-remote, segregated trust accounts)
- Insurance ≥100M EGP per firm
- Multi-firm redundancy (3 firms per jurisdiction)
- AURIENTA never touches funds; law firm API confirms receipt → Ownership Ledger updates
- Failed transfers / unclaimed dividends held indefinitely by law firm — AURIENTA has no claim
- Anti-Fragility Vault: 0.5% deducted from each raise (Add on 8)

OWNERSHIP LEDGER (Volume 2 §2.5):
- PostgreSQL append-only table with SHA3-256 hash chain
- Fields: event_id (UUID), prev_hash, payload_hash, cre_decision_token (JSONB), timestamp (BIGINT nanoseconds from HSM-synchronized clock), node_signature (Ed25519)
- "All state is derived from events. No in place updates. The immutable ledger is the source of truth."
- IPFS archiving for AI decisions, dispute evidence, board minutes, valuations (content-addressable blobs; CID stored in ledger)
- Filecoin daily snapshots (10-year retention)
- Constitutional Evidence Reconstruction: ProduceEvidence API for court-admissible evidence packages

EQUITY UNITS:
- "Each Equity Unit carries one vote."
- "Equity Units are not speculative digital assets. Equity Units represent constitutionally governed ownership participation within legally recognized enterprises."
- Workforce Partners can convert up to 10% of salary into Equity Units at 15% discount
- Founder equity varies by tier (see Tier system above)

6. Constitutional Identity Check: SHA3-256 hash of (National ID + 512-dim biometric embedding + monthly salt) checked against ledger — must be unique
7. Sanctions/PEP screening (for foreigners/high-risk)
8. Account Activation to L2; signs Constitutional Pledge (Ed25519); receives Sovereign Trust Score of 65
9. Invests 500 EGP in "Street Bites" (Tier A) → buys 10 Equity Units at 50 EGP each
10. Funds go DIRECTLY to law firm's Constitutional Escrow Vault — never to AURIENTA
11. Law firm API confirms receipt → Ownership Ledger updates within minutes
12. 0.5% (250 EGP in this example's P2 milestone illustration) to Anti-Fragility Vault
13. Layla can vote on enterprise budget, receive dividends, sell units on secondary market
14. She also becomes a Workforce Partner (delivery driver), converts 5% of salary into Equity Units at 15% discount
15. Her Sovereign Trust Score improves with consistent voting; after 2 years she may graduate to Founding Operator of her own enterprise

B) EGYPTIAN INDIVIDUAL ONBOARDING (6-step detailed, §3.2.3):
Step 1 Initial Registration → Step 2 Document Upload & AI OCR → Step 3 Liveness & Deepfake Detection → Step 4 Constitutional Identity Check (Duplicate Prevention) → Step 5 Sanctions & PEP Screening (foreigners/high-risk) → Step 6 Account Activation

C) ENTERPRISE LIFECYCLE (creation → graduation):
1. Founding Operator creates proposal (with 1-year expenses, 3-year projections, business plan, tier selection)
2. CRE Constitutional Project Evaluation Engine produces Feasibility Score
3. Score ≥35 → Pre Partnership Constitutional Consensus Phase (formerly Investor Interest Phase)
4. FUNDRAISING_ACTIVE: investors reserve shares, dynamic minimum recalculated, funds flow to escrow
5. FUNDRAISING_CLOSED: charter notarisation
6. STAGE_1 PROTECTED FORMATION (default for first 12 months): full CRE enforcement
7. STAGE_2 STRUCTURED GROWTH (auto at 12 months + governance score ≥70): reduced enforcement, alerting only
8. STAGE_3 INSTITUTIONAL INDEPENDENCE (auto at 24 months + score ≥90 + 4 profitable quarters + audit clean): read-only auditor
9. GRADUATION_PENDING (75% supermajority shareholder vote): data export and final legal steps
10. GRADUATED_SOVEREIGN: AURIENTA governance seats resign, fees cease, data exportable, enterprise may run own CRE Docker image

D) MILESTONE RELEASE WORKFLOW:
1. Manager submits milestone completion report with evidence
2. EVE (Entity Verification Engine, Volume 11) verifies evidence — geotagged photos, invoices; confidence score
3. If confidence <70% → board review
4. Treasury service calls CRE with action: "release_milestone", amount
5. CRE validates milestone approved + funds available → returns signed decision token
6. Treasury calls law firm's POST /escrow/release API with token as proof
7. Law firm verifies token (local cache of CRE public keys) + bank-level dual signature (manager + accountant) → executes transfer
8. State moves ESCROW_HELD → RELEASED
9. Fees deducted: first milestone of fiscal year = 5% platform + 2.5% consulting; subsequent = 5% platform only
10. Ownership Ledger updates; 0.5% to Anti-Fragility Vault

E) VOTING / CONSTITUTIONAL CONSENSUS:
1. Proposal DRAFT → PUBLISHED (cooling period) → VOTING_OPEN
2. Quorum requires 51% of total voting power (not just active)
3. Inactive shares default "no"
4. Real-time quorum tracking; votes execute automatically when thresholds met
5. Anonymous voting with receipt (voter identity hidden but verifiable)
6. AI detects coordinated voting patterns (e.g., 200 new accounts voting identically → invalidated)
7. QUORUM_REACHED → EXECUTED by CRE → token returned → ledger appends event

F) DIVIDEND DISTRIBUTION:
- Approved via Constitutional Consensus
- CRE token required for treasury service to initiate bank transfer
- Distributed pro rata to Constitutional Partners
- Founder dividend (Tier A): 5% of net profits paid BEFORE other dividends forever

G) SECONDARY MARKET (Volume 9 referenced, mechanics in chunk 2):
- Fundamental pricing ±5% band (10% exceptional news)
- Priority windows: exclusive pro-rata 48h → employees/founder 24h → general market
- FIFO order matching
- Liquidity reserve (LSTM model)
- Block trade rules
- MCDR integration for Tier F JSC

H) CONSULTING OPT-OUT VOTE:
- Trigger: 3 consecutive profitable quarters OR 2 years of consultancy
- ≥5% voting-power shareholder proposes "Consulting Discontinuation"
- 14-day cooling → 7-day voting → quorum 51% → simple majority passes
- If pass: consulting fees stop next fiscal year (no refund)
- If fail: 12-month minimum before next vote

I) GRADUATION:
- Stage 3 auto-transition thresholds met
- 75% supermajority shareholder vote (30-day cooling)
- Data export (cap table, historical ledger, governance records) in open formats
- AURIENTA board seat resigns; fee obligations cease
- Enterprise may run own CRE Docker image, import Ownership Ledger and past events
- Alumni Hall (graduated enterprises showcase)

J) LAW FIRM REPLACEMENT:
- After 12 months, ≥5% shareholder may propose replacement
- 14-day cooling (alternative proposals from other firms)
- Quorum 51% + simple majority
- New firm must be from AURIENTA approved list
- CRE manages transition (funds transfer within 7 days, document handover)

ONE IDENTITY RULE (non-amendable I 1.6): "One natural person, one verified identity. Duplicates result in permanent ban."

SIX IDENTITY PRINCIPLES (§3.1.1):
1. One Identity Rule
2. Portable Reputation (Sovereign Trust Score follows you)
3. Privacy by Constitutional Design (minimal data; exact salary/address never exposed)
4. Cryptographic Anchoring (Ed25519 keypair; public key on ledger)
5. Self-Sovereign Options (graduated enterprises/verified individuals can export)
6. Legal Compliance (KYC retained 5 years per AML law, then deleted; ledger events permanent)

VERIFICATION LEVELS (§3.3.1):
- L0 Anonymous — browsing only
- L1 Email/Mobile (OTP) — soft pledges, notifications
- L2 Basic KYC — National ID/passport + face match; investment up to 10,000 EGP; Capital/Workforce Partner
- L3 Enhanced KYC — ID + liveness + address proof + sanctions; investment >10,000 EGP; founding Tiers A–D; university PI
- L4 Institutional — corporate verification + UBO declaration; Tier D Founding Operator; Tier F JSC; law/accounting firms

SUPPORTED ENTITY TYPES (§3.2.1):
- Egyptian Individual (National ID) — L2 + liveness, <5 min
- Foreigner (Resident in Egypt) — L3 + law firm stamp, 48–72h
- Foreigner (Abroad) — L3 + law firm stamp + sanctions screening, 48–72h
- Egyptian Company (Commercial Register) — L4 + UBO, 3–5 days
- Foreign Company — L4 + enhanced due diligence, 5–7 days
- University (legal entity) — L3 + MoHE API, 24–48h
- University Student (Tier E special) — L2 + university endorsement (TTO), <10 min
- Law Firm — L4 + FRA license + partner background, 3–5 days
- Accounting Firm — L4 + auditor registration, 3–5 days
- Joint Stock Company (Tier F) — L4 + FRA registration + MCDR account, 3–7 days

AI VERIFICATION STACK (§3.3.4) — concrete implementation:
- OCR: Hugging Face TrOCR (microsoft/trocr-large-printed) — extracts 14-digit Egyptian National ID (2 or 3 + 13 digits, weighted-sum-mod-10 checksum)
- Liveness + Deepfake: IBM DFDC (ibm/dfdc-deepfake-detection) — real score >0.85
- Face Matching: facenet-pytorch — cosine similarity >0.6 vs ID photo
- Duplicate identity hash: SHA3-256(National ID + 512-dim biometric embedding + monthly platform salt)
- Fallback chain: HF TrOCR → Groq Llama 3.2 → Manual review (5s); HF DFDC → Groq custom vision → Manual (3s); face matching → 2s
- If all AI fails → law firm in-person verification (user-borne cost, 48h SLA)

EGYPTIAN NATIONAL ID VALIDATION:
- 14 digits; first digit 2 or 3 for individuals
- Checksum: weighted sum mod 10
- Forgery/expiry detection with specific error messages
- OCR confidence <80% → retake prompt; 3 failures → manual review

COMPANY LINKING / MULTI-ENTITY IDENTITY (§3.2.2 — Add on 24):
- After individual verification, user adds companies they own/represent
- Workflow: Settings → "My Entities" → "Add Company" → select entity type (Egyptian LLC, JSC, University SPV, Foreign Company) → enter commercial register number → GAFI API verifies legal name, status, UBO list, authorised signatories → confirm ownership (National ID match UBO, or upload notarised POA) → assign role ("Company Owner" >50%, "Legal Representative", "Authorised Signatory") → submit for verification (48h if auto-check fails) → company appears in user's Entity Selector (role switcher)
- Example: Khalil adds "Khalil Holding LLC" → recognised as 51% UBO → can invest as company, vote on company's shares, receive dividends to company bank account — all under one login

CONSTITUTIONAL IDENTITY ANCHOR (§3.1.3):
- Ed25519 keypair generated client side; private key never leaves device (secure enclave or encrypted local storage)
- Public key stored on immutable ledger under event type `identity_anchor`
- Used to sign governance actions (optional low-stakes, required high-stakes like manager removal / escrow release)

W3C VERIFIABLE CREDENTIALS (§3.9.4, §3.10):
- Every role grant produces a VC signed by AURIENTA (or law firm for escrow)
- Contains: id, issuer (DID), issuanceDate, credentialSubject (identity hash, role, enterprise ID, validity period, police clearance attestation hash for managers), proof (Ed25519 signature)
- Stored on immutable ledger; presentable to external parties (regulators, banks) without AURIENTA API calls

API ACCESS CREDENTIALS (§3.10.2):
- OAuth2 client credentials (client_id + client_secret)
- JWT for 1-hour sessions
- Refresh token valid 30 days
- API keys rotated every 90 days (30-day grace for old keys)
- All API calls validated by CRE against role permissions

AUTHENTICATION FLOWS:
- Initial: name + mobile + email + password → SMS OTP + email OTP → L1
- Password recovery: registered mobile/email OTP → ID photo + liveness video → AI matches biometric hash (similarity >0.7) → new keypair issued, old revoked
- Identity succession (incapacity): user designates recovery proxy at onboarding → verified legal declaration (court order / 2 physicians' letters) → CRE validates and executes role transfer without revealing private keys

ROLE-BASED DASHBOARDS / UNIFIED IDENTITY:
- "Unified dashboard" referenced (full spec in Volume 14, not in chunks 0-9)
- "Role switcher" / Entity Selector — user toggles between personal profile and linked company profiles under one login
- Each role inherits permissions; CRE rejects unauthorised actions
- Roles auto-revoked when: verification drops below required threshold, police clearance expires (managers), enterprise graduates (AURIENTA seat resigns), shareholder removal vote passes

SANCTIONS / PEP SCREENING (§3.8):
- Lists: OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated, UN Security Council, Egyptian FIU, GAFI API, UK Sanctions
- Llama 3.2 70B via Groq fuzzy matching (handles "Muhammad" vs "Mohamed")
- >90% confidence → automatic flag, blocked, compliance notified
- 70–90% → human review (48h SLA)
- Daily re-screening for all L3/L4 users at 03:00 Cairo time
- Sanctions match post-onboarding → immediate account freeze; enterprises notified; accelerated Graduation vote possible

INVESTOR RISK PROFILING (§3.9.3 — optional):

- Diversification caps: Conservative 5%, Balanced 10%, Aggressive 20%, Founder Aligned 25% (own enterprise only)

# AURIENTA BLUEPRINT — STRUCTURED REPORT (Chunks 10–18, Volumes 4[end]→10)

## 1. AI SYSTEMS — Every AI Agent/Assistant Named

### 1.1 JOZOUR v3 Valuation & Constitutional Pricing Engine (Volume 6)
Deterministic, constitutionally enforced valuation engine. "JOZOUR (meaning 'roots' in Arabic) is the deterministic, constitutionally enforced valuation engine of AURIENTA." It computes (a) pre-money valuation at fundraising and (b) daily fundamental price for secondary market.

**7-step algorithm with explicit AI roles:**
| Step | Component | Weight | AI Model | Role |
|------|-----------|--------|----------|------|
| 1 | Revenue × Sector Multiple | 40% | None (pure math) | CAPMAS/EGX sector P/E |
| 2 | Net Assets | 25% | None | Book value |
| 3 | Cost Adjustments | embedded | None | Strip one-time/non-cash items + AURIENTA fees |
| 4 | Scorecard Comparison | 20% | Rule-based (deterministic) | EBITDA margin vs sector median → 0.8–1.3 multiplier |
| 5 | Growth Potential | 10% | **Gemma 2 27B** (HF; fallback Llama 3.2 70B via Groq) | NLP analysis of business plan, optional materials, market data, GAFI incentives → multiplier 0.7–1.9 |
| 6 | Founder Premium | 5% | **Llama 3.2 70B via Groq** (low latency) | Pattern match on trust score, exits, experience, team, Tier D history → 0–12% bonus |
| 7 | Sanity Check | ±20% cap | **Mixtral 8x22B** (HF; fallback human Steward if confidence <70%) | Full AI oversight, may adjust final value ±20% with plain-language reason + confidence 0–100 |

Final formula: `Pre-money = (Step1 + Step2) × Step4 × Step5 × (1 + Step6) × (1 + Step7)`, rounded to nearest 50,000 EGP.

### 1.2 Fraud Detection AI (Volume 5 §5.8.1)
**Model: Llama 3.2 70B via Groq.** Real-time pattern analysis. Indicators & thresholds:
- Duplicate reference codes across investors → flag/manual review
- Suspiciously large investments from new low-rep accounts (>200,000 EGP AND score <30) → temporary 2h hold
- Coordinated payments from same bank account to >3 enterprises within 1 hour → money-mule flag
- Unusual timing (3+ investments within 1 hour outside 8am–8pm) → flag
- Inflated milestone evidence (EVE confidence <50%) → reject milestone, notify board
- Confidence >70% → 2h human review hold; >85% → emergency Level 3 freeze.

### 1.3 Governance AI (Volume 7 §7.8)
**Model: Mixtral 8x22B.** For each proposal produces a risk score (0–100, lower=better), risk factors list, recommendation, confidence. Also optional AI voting recommendations based on voter history. Monitors anomalies: vote buying, proposal spam, board capture risk (same person on competing boards), social insurance non-compliance. Outputs JSON with `proposal_id, risk_score, risk_factors[], recommendation, confidence`.

### 1.4 AI Salary Engine (Volume 8 §8.4)
**Model: Llama 3.2 via Groq.** Formula: `Salary = Base × Tier_multiplier × Performance_score × Regional_adjustment × Profit_factor`.
- Tier multipliers: A=0.8, B=1.0, C=1.3, D=1.5, E=0.9, F=1.5
- Regional: Cairo=1.0, Alex=0.9, Delta=0.85, Upper Egypt=0.8, Suez=0.95
- Performance 0.5–1.5; Profit factor 0.8–1.2 (quarterly)
- Llama 3.2 YES/NO sanity check; if NO, falls back to neutral performance (1.0)
- Board override allowed by 75% vote; >200% of AI salary triggers automatic shareholder notification.

### 1.5 AI Mediated Dispute Prevention (Volume 10 §10.2)
**Model: Mixtral 8x22B.** Continuous monitoring for dispute signals (vote polarisation >30%, manager-board disagreement >2/30 days, late reports >2 quarters, whistleblower reports confidence >70%, accountant vetoes manager >3/30 days, social insurance non-compliance, police record rejection). If probability >65%: sends 72h early warning, proposes 3 compromise solutions ranked by acceptance_probability, offers 48h cooling-off period. AI-generated compromises via prompt; output is JSON `solutions[]` with description + acceptance_probability.

### 1.6 Whistleblower Validation AI (Volume 8 §8.10.2)
**Model: Mixtral 8x22B.** Assesses whistleblower report credibility 0–100 without revealing reporter identity. Evaluates internal consistency, alignment with immutable ledger events, historical context, corroborating evidence. Confidence ≥70% → "validated", anonymised summary sent to board; <70% → stored 180 days.

### 1.7 Key Person Risk Detection AI (Volume 8 §8.10.1)
**Model: Llama 3.2.** Analyses role criticality (absence impact >10% revenue for 30 days), succession plan status (Ready/In Progress/None), knowledge transfer completion %, voluntary turnover probability. Flags Key Person on board dashboard; unresolved >90 days escalates to shareholder vote.

### 1.8 AI Manipulation Detection (Volume 9 §9.8.3)
**Model: Llama 3.2.** Monitors wash trading, layering, quote stuffing. Confidence >85%: orders cancelled, partners suspended 30 days (1st offence) or permanently (2nd), reputation −25 points.

### 1.9 Sell Pressure Forecasting (Volume 9 §9.9)
**Model: LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural network, PyTorch.** Input features (last 30 days): daily sell/buy volume, price volatility, sector sentiment, macro indicators (EGX, USD/EGP). Output: probability of sell imbalance >20% of avg daily volume for next 7 days. Thresholds: <0.4 normal; 0.4–0.6 alert Stewards; 0.6–0.8 pre-emptively expand band to ±10% for 3 days; >0.8 activate liquidity reserve. Retrained weekly.

### 1.10 AI for Escrow Clause NLP Validation (Volume 5 §5.2.1)
**Model: Llama 3.2.** Validates the bankruptcy-remote clause in escrow account agreements via natural language processing before any deposit is accepted.

### 1.11 Referenced but defined in Volume 11 (not fully in my chunks)
- **EVE (Execution Verification Engine)** — validates payroll runs (discrepancy >10% flags), milestone evidence (confidence scoring), receipt extraction via **LayoutLMv3**.
- **Reality Synchronisation Engine** — daily audits of law firm integrations (§5.1.3 reference).
- **Institutional Memory Engine** — IPFS storage of valuation reports, training data for AI.
- **Institutional Intelligence Graph** — flags board conflicts of interest (§7.7.4).

### 1.12 CRE (Constitutional Runtime Engine) — the core enforcement layer
Not itself an AI; it is the deterministic rule engine that validates every action via **Rego policies** (Volume 18). It rejects any instruction violating non-amendable rules (e.g., Zero Custody Rule I 1.1, Fundamental Only Pricing I 1.3). It does NOT propose or vote — "AI as Enforcer, Not Decider" (Volume 1, AI Governance Philosophy). It executes votes automatically when quorum is reached and outcome is determinable.

## 4. CLOSED-LOOP SYSTEMS — Exact Mechanics

### 4.1 Capital / Fundraising Loop (Volume 5 §5.3)
1. **Reservation** — Partner clicks "Reserve Shares" → unique reference code `AURI-{YYYY}-{enterprise_id}-{partner_id}-{timestamp_hash}`
2. **Payment Instructions** — IBAN + reference + amount (shares × AI price, 1% tolerance for bank fees)
3. **Transfer** — InstaPay/Fawry/mobile wallet/bank wire/cross-border bridge
4. **Webhook** — law firm POSTs `/api/v1/webhook/payment` (mTLS + Ed25519)
5. **CRE Validation** — reference active, amount matches ±1%, not duplicate, project in fundraising
6. **Escrow Update & Ledger** — CONFIRMED, Ownership Ledger updated, digital share certificate generated, 0.5% → Anti-Fragility Vault
7. **Settlement** — funds held in escrow until milestone approved → CRE authorises release → law firm transfers to enterprise operating account

Reservation state machine: `RESERVED (48h timer) → PENDING_VALIDATION → CONFIRMED → SETTLED`. Failure paths: `EXPIRED` (−10 reputation points; 2nd offence within 12 months → 30-day reservation ban), `INVALID_AMOUNT` (>1% variance → 24h manual review), `DUPLICATE_REFERENCE` (second payment rejected + refund).

### 4.2 Governance / Voting Loop (Volume 7 §7.4)
`PROPOSED → PUBLISHED → VOTING_OPEN → QUORUM_REACHED → EXECUTED` (or `REJECTED` / `EXPIRED`). CRE counts votes in real time; may execute early when outcome is determinable even if all remaining votes went the other way.

### 4.3 Milestone Release Loop (Volume 5 + 8)
Milestone proposed → EVE verifies evidence (confidence threshold) → board approval → CRE transfers from primary vault to Milestone Release Sub-account (dual signature: Manager + Independent Accountant) → law firm transfers to vendor → logged on immutable ledger.

### 4.4 Dividend Loop (Volume 8 §8.11.3)
Board declares → **Dividend Sustainability Test**: post-dividend runway ≥12 months, net profit after dividend positive, social insurance & tax current. If passes → CRE transfers to Dividend Distribution Account → law firm distributes (automated, no human signatory) → 10% withholding tax for Egyptian residents (treaty rates for foreigners) → ledger update.

### 4.5 Salary-to-Equity Loop (Volume 8 §8.3)
Employee elects % (max 10% of gross) → discounted price = AI price × 0.85 → shares = amount / discounted price → CRE validates employment ≥6 months, monthly limit, pool sufficiency → payroll deducts → shares issued with `restricted_until` 12 months → on graduation, all restricted shares immediately vest. Employee pool = 5% of total outstanding at fundraising close (3% auto-conversion, 2% discretionary board grants).

### 4.6 Escrow Reconciliation Loop (Volume 5 §5.5–5.6)
Every 60s: law firm produces signed balance assertion (Ed25519) → CRE compares to ledger → variance triggers:
- Level 1 (>0.1% for <4h): log, internal Stewards only
- Level 2 (>2% OR >0.1% for >4h): pause non-essential outlays, notify board, all partners see flag
- Level 3 (unauthorised withdrawal OR >10%): freeze all escrow, halt trading, legal alert, all + regulator
Daily job 02:00 Cairo time. Manual fallback: PDF bank statement if API down >1h.

### 4.7 Dispute Resolution Loop (Volume 10 §10.3)
`POTENTIAL_DISPUTE (AI detection) → FORMAL_DISPUTE_FILED → AI_MEDIATION (48h) → BOARD_REVIEW (72h) → SHAREHOLDER_VOTE (72h) → ARBITRATION (CRCICA, 30 days) → APPEAL (external civil court)`. Each stage can `→ RESOLVED → CLOSED`.

### 4.8 Whistleblower Loop (Volume 8 §8.10.2)
Submission (metadata stripped, random tracking code `WB-7X3F9-K2L8M`, encrypted, Class C vault) → Mixtral credibility score 0–100 → ≥70% validated → anonymised summary to board → board votes within 7 days (simple majority) on investigation (funded up to 100,000 EGP from escrow) → independent investigator → if confirmed: recovery → 10% bounty to whistleblower (capped 100,000 EGP) → manager reputation reset.

### 4.9 Audit / Compliance Loop (Volume 4 §4.11.4)
Audit opinion → consequences:
- Unqualified → no action
- Qualified → 60-day remediation plan; if unresolved 120 days → health rating downgraded 1 grade
- Adverse → automatic escrow freeze, FRA + shareholders notified 24h, manager reputation −30, Constitutional Appeal Court auto-review
- Disclaimer → same as adverse + governance watch (Vol 16 §16.14.2)
Remediation: 30 days engage forensic accountant, 60 days remediation plan to FRA, 120 days implement, else CRE initiates forced dissolution.

### 4.10 Graduation Loop
Tiers A→B (consulting opt-out after 3 profitable quarters or 2 years), B→C (fast track), E spinout graduation (referenced; full mechanics in later volumes). Tier F → EGX listing support. Tier A subsidy ceases at graduation to B.

### 4.11 Failover Loop (Volume 5 §5.2.2)
CRE monitors firm health (API heartbeat 60s <500ms, license daily, solvency, SLA). Failover triggers: license suspension, insolvency, API outage >4h, material breach (AI confidence ≥90%). Execution ≤2h: freeze → backup selection → migration package (Ed25519-signed) → fund transfer (cooperative 24h, or court-ordered 48h) → notification. Post-failover: board ratifies within 30 days (simple majority) or 75% supermajority to revert.

## 5. KPIs & QUALITY GATES — Exact Metrics & Thresholds

### 5.1 Audit Quality Gates (Volume 4 §4.11.4.5)
Unqualified / Qualified / Adverse / Disclaimer — see §4.9 above.

### 5.2 Escrow Health Flags (Volume 5 §5.5)
- Level 1: variance >0.1% for <4h
- Level 2: variance >2% OR >0.1% for >4h
- Level 3: unauthorised withdrawal OR variance >10%

### 5.3 Capital Efficiency Score (Volume 8 §8.11.1)
`Score = (Annual Revenue / Total Capital Deployed) × 50 + (Gross Margin %) × 0.5 + (Revenue Growth YoY %) × 0.5`
- Excellent >80 | Good 60–80 | Warning 40–60 | Critical <40 (triggers board review)

### 5.4 Burn Rate / Runway (Volume 8 §8.11.2)
Runway = escrow balance / monthly burn. Alert if <6 months → board must present recovery plan within 30 days.

### 5.5 Dividend Sustainability Test (Volume 8 §8.11.3)
Post-dividend runway ≥12 months; net profit after dividend positive; SI & tax current. Fails → auto-blocked (board may override with 90% vote).

### 5.6 AI Confidence Thresholds
- Dispute probability >65% → 72h early warning (Mixtral)
- Whistleblower credibility ≥70% → validated; ≥85% → board must vote within 7 days
- Fraud confidence >70% → 2h hold; >85% → emergency freeze
- Manipulation confidence >85% → orders cancelled, suspend 30 days
- Sanity check confidence <70% → adjustment rejected, Steward reviews in 48h
- Exceptional news Mixtral confidence >90% → band expands ±5% → ±10% for 7 days
- Escrow fraud AI confidence ≥90% → material breach trigger

### 5.7 Voting Thresholds
- Quorum: 51% (shareholder), 50% (board)
- Simple majority: manager appointment/removal, budget >10%, law firm replacement (after 12mo)
- 75% supermajority: constitutional amendment, graduation, merger/acquisition, dissolution, emergency freeze, board override of accountant veto
- 90%: removal of AURIENTA as platform

### 5.8 Quarterly Valuation Timeline (Add-on 20, Volume 6 §6.5)
- T−14: system reminder to prepare financials
- T+0 (quarter end, 23:59 Cairo): financials submitted
- T+1 to T+3: AI validation (EVE + JOZOUR models)
- T+4: JOZOUR v3 valuation computed
- T+5: valuation report published
- T+6 to T+13: 7-day challenge window (500 EGP fee, refundable if succeeds)
- T+14: final valuation effective (retroactive to T+5 if no challenge)

### 5.9 Late Submission Penalties (Volume 6 §6.5.2, Volume 8 §8.8.4)
- 1–14 days: reputation −5, yellow flag
- 15–30 days: reputation −15, freeze on new expense approvals
- >30 days: escrow freeze, board notified, possible manager removal vote

### 5.10 Budget Utilisation Alerts (Volume 8 §8.14.8)
- Green ≤80% | Yellow 80–100% | Red >100% (blocks expenses until board amendment)
- ≥90% yellow alert notification; ≥95% manager must justify; ≥100% CRE blocks

### 5.11 Social Insurance Compliance (Volume 8 §8.5)
- 30 days grace to register with NOSI
- 45 days: manager reputation reduced
- 60 days: escrow freeze for new expense approvals

### 5.12 Escrow SLA for Law Firms (Volume 5 §5.2.4)
- Uptime ≥99.5%, response ≤500ms (balance/transactions), ≤2s (release), webhook latency ≤5s
- 2 consecutive months failing → probation; 3 months in any rolling 12 → permanent removal

### 5.13 Reservation Expiry
- 48h no payment → EXPIRED, −10 reputation; 2nd offence within 12 months → 30-day reservation ban.

### 5.14 Price Band Violations
- ±5% normal (Phase 3); ±10% exceptional news (7 days); Phase 1/2 no band (price = CPP exactly)
- Prometheus alert `CPPBandViolationSpike` if rate >10 in 10 minutes.

### 5.15 Circuit Breakers (Volume 9 §9.8.2)
- >10 trades within band limit in 1 hour → Level 1: 1h pause
- Two Level 1 events in 24h → Level 2: 24h pause
- AI manipulation confidence >85% → Level 3: pause until investigation (max 7 days)

### 5.16 Liquidity Reserve Activation
- Sell orders > buy orders for 5 consecutive days AND not exceptional news AND reserve covers ≥10% of backlog
- Reserve buys entire backlog (up to 50% of reserve balance per day) at reference price
- Recoupment within 90 days

### 5.17 Sell Pressure LSTM Thresholds
<0.4 normal | 0.4–0.6 alert | 0.6–0.8 expand band ±10% for 3 days | >0.8 activate reserve pre-emptively

### 5.18 Key Person Risk
- Role absence impact >10% revenue for 30 days → flag
- Unresolved >90 days → escalate to shareholder vote (manager may be removed for negligence)

### 5.19 Anti-Concentration
- No single shareholder >49% voting power (excess becomes non-voting until sold)
- Investor representatives capped at 3 per enterprise
- Tier D: any new investor >25% requires owner consent (75% board vote)

## 7. ENTERPRISE LIFECYCLE — States & Transitions

### 7.1 Tier Progression (Volume 4 conclusion)
- **Tier A (Micro Enterprise)** — first-time founders, LLC, max 3M EGP, 5% founder equity, 5% service + 2.5% consulting fee, consulting opt-out after 3 profitable quarters or 2 years. Dynamic minimum investment (Add-on 19). Initial law firm/accountant appointment by AURIENTA (Add-on 28).
- **Tier B (Small Enterprise)** — experienced operators, LLC, max 25M EGP, 5% + conditional 5% founder equity, fast track to Tier C.
- **Tier C (Growth Enterprise)** — LLC, unlimited raise, 10% + 25% vesting, 35% performance profit share, ERP mandatory, police record check.
- **Tier D (Established Enterprise)** — existing companies, LLC, unlimited, owner control preserved (>51%), dynamic sliding scale, related party disclosure, ERP mandatory.
- **Tier E (University Research)** — SPV, max 5M, 0% founder equity, 1% service fee (no consulting), research incentives, spinout graduation.
- **Tier F (Joint Stock Company)** — JSC, unlimited, board-appointed CEO, FRA compliance, MCDR integration, EGX listing support, ERP mandatory.

All tiers (except E): 5% platform service fee + 2.5% consulting fee deducted from milestone releases; consulting mandatory until 3 profitable quarters or 2 years, then opt-out by shareholder vote. No equity fee.

`RESERVED → PENDING_VALIDATION → CONFIRMED → SETTLED` | `EXPIRED` | `INVALID_AMOUNT` | `DUPLICATE_REFERENCE`

`PROPOSED → PUBLISHED → VOTING_OPEN → QUORUM_REACHED → EXECUTED` | `REJECTED` | `EXPIRED`

### 7.4 Manager Lifecycle (Volume 7 §7.5)
Appointment (police record check, Add-on 27) → Duties (operations, financial mgmt, reporting, milestones, NOSI registration) → Authority limits (<1% alone, 1–10% dual sig, >10% board) → Removal (5-step protocol, Art. 118) → Interim succession (14 days to elect permanent).

`REQUESTED → DUAL_SIGNATURE_PENDING → CRE_VALIDATION → LAW_FIRM_EXECUTION → SETTLED` | `REJECTED (signature missing)` | `REJECTED (CRE denial)`

See §4.7.

### 7.7 Audit Lifecycle (Volume 4 §4.11)

## 8. VOTING & GOVERNANCE MECHANICS

### 8.1 Core Mechanics (Volume 7 §7.4.1)
- 1 Equity Unit = 1 vote (One Share, One Vote; no super-voting, no founder vetoes)
- Quorum: 51% of total voting power (shareholder); 50% (board)
- Inactive shares count as "NO" for removal votes (prevents small active minority)
- Proxy voting: allowed with digital authorisation (Ed25519 signature)
- Voting period: 48–72h (shareholder), 24h (board)
- Automatic execution when quorum reached AND outcome determinable (early execution)

### 8.2 Proposal Types (Volume 7 §7.4.3)
| Proposal Type | Min Support to Propose | Fee (EGP) | Cooling | Voting Period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manager appointment | Any board member | 0 | 24h | 48h |
| Manager removal | ≥5% voting power OR any board member | 500 (refundable if passes) | 48h | 72h |
| Budget (>10% capital) | Manager or board | 0 | 48h | 48h |
| Dividend declaration | Board | 0 | 7 days (notice) | 24h (board) |
| Constitutional amendment (enterprise) | ≥10% voting power | 2,000 | 90 days | 14 days |
| Graduation | ≥5% voting power | 1,000 (refundable if passes) | 30 days | 14 days |
| Emergency freeze override | Any board member | 0 | 0 | 24h (board) |
| Law firm/accountant replacement | ≥5% voting power (after 12 months) | 500 | 14 days | 7 days |

### 8.3 Authority Domains (Volume 7 §7.2.1)
- Strategic direction (merger, graduation, dissolution): Constitutional Partners, 75% supermajority
- Budget >10% capital: Constitutional Council (board)
- Budget 1–10%: Manager + Independent Accountant (dual signature)
- Budget <1%: Manager only (within approved budget)
- Manager appointment: Constitutional Partners or board (tier-dependent), simple majority, quorum 51%
- Manager removal: Constitutional Partners (General Assembly per Art. 118, NOT board — except Tier D with delegation)
- Constitutional amendment (enterprise): 75% + 90-day cooling
- Emergency freeze: Board (75%) or AI auto-trigger
- Dividend declaration: Board (subject to tier retention rules)

### 8.4 AURIENTA Representative Veto — 6 Categories Only (Volume 7 §7.6.1)
1. Change to zero custody rule (non-amendable)
2. Move escrow to non-approved law firm
3. Action violating Egyptian/local law (tax evasion, unlicensed activity)
4. Sale of company assets >50% of valuation without shareholder vote
5. Merger/acquisition diluting AURIENTA platform equity without compensation (legacy)
6. Removal of AURIENTA as platform (requires 90% shareholder vote, NOT vetoable)

No veto on: day-to-day ops, hiring/firing (except C-suite), normal expenses, dividend amounts (unless illegal), manager removal votes.

### 8.5 Anti-Capture Safeguards (Volume 7 §7.7)
- Term limits: AURIENTA rep 5yr×2 max; Independent Accountant 2yr×2 then rotate firm; Investor rep 1yr unlimited (annual re-election); External independent director 3yr×2 + 1yr cooling
- Supermajorities: 75% amendment/graduation/merger/dissolution; 90% remove AURIENTA
- Concentration: no shareholder >49% (excess non-voting); max 3 investor reps; Tier D new investor >25% needs owner consent
- Conflict of interest recusal enforced by AI (Institutional Intelligence Graph)

### 8.6 Board Composition by Tier (Volume 7 §7.3.1)
| Role | A | B | C | D | E | F |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Founder/owner rep | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No (univ rep) | Yes |
| Manager | Optional (12mo) | Optional (elected) | Default founder | Owner default | PI (non-voting) | CEO (board-appointed) |
| Independent Accountant | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes/univ finance | Yes (audit cmte) |
| Investor rep (>10%) | No | Yes (1) | Yes (1–3) | Yes (1–3) | No | Yes if institutional |
| AURIENTA rep | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Advisory | Observer (non-voting) |
| University rep | No | No | No | No | Yes (voting) | No |
| External independent director | No | Optional | Optional | Optional | No | Required (≥1) |
| Total size | 3 | 3–5 | 5 | 5–9 | 3 | 4–7 |

Board meeting frequency: A/B quarterly, C/D monthly, E quarterly, F monthly (or FRA-required). Quorum 50%, notice 7 days regular / 24h emergency. Minutes stored on ledger (Tier F filed with FRA).

### 8.7 Manager Removal 5-Step Protocol (Volume 7 §7.5.3, Art. 118 Compliance)
1. Pre-vote AI analysis (Mixtral 8x22B): success probability, governance score, historical performance; if dispute escalation >65%, 72h early warning suggesting mediation
2. Vote initiation: 48h notice, AI impact report (financial/operational/legal)
3. Voting period 48–72h; simple majority of votes cast; quorum 51%; inactive = "no"
4. Post-vote execution: CRE notarises via law firm API; Tier C manager loses 35% profit share + unvested equity; other tiers fully revoked within 1h
5. Interim management: AI suggests candidates (high reputation, relevant expertise, must pass police check); shareholder vote within 14 days

### 8.8 Rego Enforcement (Volume 7 §7.6.2)
```rego
deny["Manager removal must be by General Assembly, not board"] {
  input.action == "remove_manager"
  enterprise = data.enterprises[input.enterprise_id]
  enterprise.removal_rule == "general_assembly"
  input.removing_body == "board"
}
deny["AURIENTA representative veto triggered"] {
  input.action == "board_resolution"
  input.resolution_type in [1,2,3,4,5]
  input.veto_cast_by == "aurienta_rep"
  input.veto_signature_valid
}
```

### 8.9 Emergency Governance (Volume 7 §7.10)
- Emergency board meeting: 24h notice; can vote emergency freeze (75%), approve urgent expenses >10% capital without shareholder vote (ratify within 7 days), appoint interim manager (police check within 7 days)
- Emergency shareholder vote: if board deadlocked 30 days, ≥10% aggregate voting power can call; bypasses cooling periods
- Constitutional succession: pre-registered voting proxy + pre-registered emergency manager (60-day operational control, police clearance within 7 days)

   - Referral path for criminal violations (embezzlement, forgery, tax evasion, social-insurance fraud). AURIENTA provides complete evidence package (Volume 10 §10.9).

I. CRCICA (Cairo Regional Centre for International Commercial Arbitration)
   - Default arbitration venue for Egyptian enterprises. Other jurisdictions: DIAC (UAE), LCIA India (India). Awards enforceable under Egyptian Arbitration Law No. 27/1994.

J. Constitutional Council (Global)
   - Proposes global constitutional amendments (75% supermajority required, binding on all enterprises). Codifies arbitration-award interpretations into constitutional rules.

K. Other Regulators/Registries Integrated
   - GAFI (General Authority for Investment): CR verification, UBO fetch, foreign-investor registration, incentives query, golden-license application.

3. SECONDARY MARKET — TRADING, PRICING, RULES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Pricing:
- Share price = AI fundamental price per Equity Unit (Gemma 2 27B Valuation Agent + Mixtral 8x22B Sanity Agent). Expressed as CPP (Constitutional Percentage Price) — EGP per 1% ownership — and per-share EGP.
- Constitutional Price Band: ±5% around AI price (expandable to ±10% in some tiers). UI shows "Allowed range: 54.26 – 59.98 EGP (±5%)". Price input is READ-ONLY in order form (no price negotiation).
- No order book displayed (anti-speculation). Shows only: available % for sale by phase, estimated fill time, buy-side interest count, your pro rata entitlement.

Trading Mechanics — Three-Phase Priority Windows (per sell order):
- Phase 1 (48h): Exclusive pro rata window — only existing shareholders may buy, in proportion to current ownership. "Your pro rata entitlement: 0.25% (based on your 10% ownership)".
- Phase 2 (24h): Employees + founder window.
- Phase 3 (general market): Open to all AURIENTA Capital Partners.
- Tier A enterprises: ONLY Phase 1 + Phase 2 active; Phase 3 DISABLED. Plus monthly cap — no shareholder may change ownership % by >10% per calendar month (anti-flipping).
- Tiers B/C/D/F: All three phases active, no monthly cap.
- Tier E (university research): Secondary market COMPLETELY DISABLED.
- Tier F (listed JSC): EGX trading is independent; AURIENTA secondary market remains available but CPP band applies only to AURIENTA-side trades.

Fees & Tax:
- Platform fee: 0.5% (shown in order form).
- Capital gains tax: 10% for Egyptian residents (auto-withheld). Foreign investors: treaty rate applied automatically (e.g., UK-Egypt treaty 0% dividends if >10% ownership, 5% if <10%; portfolio secondary-market gains typically 0%).
- Form 41 (capital gains) auto-generated per trade using FIFO cost basis; quarterly XML submission to Tax Authority.

Fractional Shares:
- Whole shares only. Floor(locked_target_amount / AI_price). Residual refunded to investor's source account.

Order Entry Form component (TypeScript interface):
- companyId, currentPrice, bandPercent (5|10), phase (1|2|3), proRataEntitlement, maxShares, onPlaceOrder(side, shares, price).

Cross-Border Trading (Volume 13):
- Foreign investors may trade; FX rate locked at reservation click via decentralised oracle (Chainlink 40% + Binance 20% + Refinitiv 20% + Central Bank of Egypt 20%, median consensus, 48h lock).
- 1% surcharge for cross-border services (correspondent banking, FX hedging, enhanced due diligence).
- No crypto/stablecoin settlement. Fiat only via regulated banks (Wise, Revolut, correspondent banks, M-Pesa, Flutterwave).

4. GRADUATION / TIER F (JOINT STOCK COMPANIES)
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Four Constitutional Maturity Stages (Volume 15 §15.2.1):
- Stage 1 — Protected Formation (0-12 months): Full CRE enforcement, all rules active. CRE token required for expense approvals <1% capital; dual signature + CRE for 1-10%; salary AI enforced; milestone release = EVE + board; AURIENTA board seat = voting.
- Stage 2 — Structured Growth (12-24 months, requires governance score ≥70): Alerting only (no auto-block). Manager-only approval (logged) for <1%; dual signature (CRE optional) for 1-10%; salary AI advisory; EVE board optional.
- Stage 3 — Institutional Independence (24-36 months, requires governance score ≥90 + 4 consecutive profitable quarters + clean audit + NOSI compliance + police-clearance current): Read-only auditor, no enforcement. Manager-only approval (not logged); dual signature (no CRE); salary AI optional; manager-only milestone release; AURIENTA board seat may resign by board vote.
- Stage 4 — Sovereign Enterprise (graduated, indefinite): No platform role. Requires 75% shareholder vote + readiness verification.

Stage Transitions:
- Stage 1→2 and Stage 2→3 AUTOMATIC (no board vote) when thresholds met. CRE continuously evaluates (Python `evaluate_stage_transition`).
- Stage 3→4 (graduation) REQUIRES active shareholder vote (75% supermajority).

Stage 3 Additional Compliance Thresholds (Add-ons 26, 27):
- All employees registered with NOSI for ≥6 months.
- Manager police clearance valid (issued within last 6 months).
- No unresolved social-insurance or police-clearance flags for 12 months.

Graduation Readiness Score (quarterly, 0-100; graduation requires ≥90):
- Governance maturity 30% — no constitutional violations in 24 months, board attendance >90%.
- Financial stability 25% — runway >18 months, revenue growth >20% YoY, profit margin >10%.
- Operational independence 20% — no key person risk, documented succession plans, employee turnover <15%.
- Compliance history 15% — all tax filings on time, no regulatory inquiries, audit clean, NOSI 100% compliant, police clearance current.
- Platform dependency reduction 10% — enterprise has reduced reliance on CRE (Stage 3 features used).

What Graduation Means (Before → After):
- Governance enforcement: CRE validates all actions → No CRE enforcement (enterprise may run own instance).
- Platform fee: 5% service + 2.5% consulting (if not opted out) → 0% (optional paid services available).
- AURIENTA board seat: Voting member (or observer Tier F) → Resigned.
- Data hosting: AURIENTA infrastructure → Enterprise controlled (or optional paid hosting).
- Secondary market: Via AURIENTA → Enterprise may operate its own or use AURIENTA as paid service.
- Constitutional rules: Enforced by CRE → Enterprise may modify (but loses "constitutional" certification).
- Social insurance & police clearance: Monitored by CRE → Enterprise's own responsibility (optional AURIENTA advisory).

Graduation Mechanics:
- 30-day data export initiated by CRE.
- CRE resigns the AURIENTA board seat.
- Full ledger transferred to enterprise's own servers.
- Enterprise appears in "Alumni Hall" as a sovereign enterprise.
- Enterprise may run its own CRE instance (open source, Apache 2.0 license).

Graduation vs. Other Exits:
- Graduation = enterprise becomes independent, leaves platform (THE GOAL).
- Dissolution = winds down, distributes assets (terminal state).
- Acquisition = sold to another company (may trigger graduation or dissolution).
- IPO = lists on public exchange ("ultimate graduation, platform independent").

Tier F (Joint Stock Company) — Listed Path:
- Tier F is the LISTED tier. MCDR/EGX integration feeds (public disclosures) appear in dashboard activity feed.
- AURIENTA's secondary market remains available for Tier F, but CPP band applies only to AURIENTA-side trades (EGX trading is independent).
- Example cited: "SmartFarm Egypt graduates from AURIENTA as a Tier C enterprise, then later converts to a Tier F Joint Stock Company and lists on the EGX. The IPO is a separate event, but the enterprise is already independent of AURIENTA."
- AURIENTA rep on Tier F board is OBSERVER (not voting).
- Public profile adds "FRA filings and EGX corporate actions."

Cross-Border Graduation (Volume 13 §13.12.1):
- Graduation package includes: export of cap table with multi-currency cost basis; legal opinion on cross-border equity transfer (may require new entity formation); option to migrate CRE instance to jurisdiction of choice; police-clearance and social-insurance portability guidance.

6. SECURITY & COMPLIANCE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Audit:
- Internal Legal Audit (quarterly): rotating panel of independent lawyers reviews 10% sample of Constitutional Charters, all disputes with arbitration, AI model approval documentation, social-insurance and police-clearance compliance.
- External Regulatory Audit (annual): FRA or local regulator; read-only terminal access, ability to replay any event, dedicated compliance liaison. Findings published aggregated; remediation within 90 days.
- Independent Constitutional Auditor: reviews FRA dashboard usage quarterly, publishes anonymised report on ledger.
- Forensic Auditor (per shareholder review request): randomly selected, 14-day review, court-admissible report with evidence hashes.
- Constitutional AI Oversight (Volume 11 §11.4): independent Gemma 2 7B model audits all AI models for hallucination (>90% confidence triggers review), bias (demographic parity >20% disparity triggers alert), drift (KL divergence >0.1 alert, >0.2 auto-rollback).

Immutability:
- Every ledger event is hash-chained (SHA3-256 for chat messages, Ed25519 signatures for CRE decisions).
- Constitutional Chat messages: hash includes content + author identity hash + nanosecond timestamp + channel + reference to previous message hash (channel-specific hash chain). DELETION IMPOSSIBLE — "even the AURIENTA Chief Steward cannot remove a message". Edits append correction records.
- Hourly Merkle tree of all governance actions; root hash published to immutable ledger AND anchored to Stellar blockchain for external verifiability.
- Institutional Memory Engine: IPFS + Filecoin (10-year renewable retention, funded by 0.5% of cash fee).
- Oracle Mirror Survival System: physical hard-copy constitution (3 signed copies in fireproof/waterproof safes at enterprise, law firm, AURIENTA off-site). Activates if platform unreachable 7 consecutive days. Paper ballots with pre-printed voting weights. Reconciliation on platform return: accountant inputs physical decisions, CRE validates against Mirror Constitution rules, valid decisions backdated to ledger.

Encryption:
- At rest: AES-256 (Class B ledger, Class C KYC, Class E AI logs, Class F police clearance, Class G social insurance).
- In transit: TLS.
- Biometric hashes (Class D): HSM-only, never in database, matching service only.
- End-to-end encryption for private Constitutional Chat channels (board, auditor) — recipients' public keys; ledger stores ciphertext only.
- Public chat channel: plaintext (transparency).
- HSM-backed regulatory signing key for FRA reports.
- Constitutional Identity Anchor (Volume 3 §3.1.3) manages encryption keys.

KYC / AML:
- Class C KYC documents: ID scans, selfies (retained 10 years after account closure).
- Class D biometric hashes: liveness videos, face embeddings, voice prints (1 year after closure).
- Family relationship data (for conflict-of-interest detection): collected only with explicit consent at onboarding (checkbox); hashed, segregated encrypted vault; users may withdraw consent anytime (disables family-based detection only).
- AML Law 80/2002 compliance: UBO disclosure mandatory; sanctions screening against OFAC/EU/UN/local FIU lists daily; enhanced due diligence for cross-border transactions >50,000 EGP (source-of-funds declaration, proof of wealth, additional UBO disclosure).
- Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) auto-pushed to FIU within 24h when AI fraud confidence >70%.
- Annual AML/KYC audit trail pushed to FRA every 31 March.
- CRS (Common Reporting Standard): TINs collected at onboarding; annual auto-exchange with investor's home country.
- Sanctions flag example: name match cleared manually by compliance steward after review.
- Capital controls: AURIENTA warns investors of local limits (e.g., Egypt 100,000 USD annual individual outbound) but does not enforce — investor's responsibility.

Fraud Detection & Prevention:
- Automatic Conflict of Interest Disclosure (Volume 11 §11.1.4): continuous graph query every 60 seconds detects shareholder→vendor, board→counterparty, manager→self-dealing, circular ownership, family triangle, social-insurance evasion, police-clearance failure. Llama 3.2 70B computes confidence (0-100). <50% logged; 50-74% yellow flag (paused, board notified, 48h to investigate); ≥75% red flag (auto-freeze, recusal, board vote within 7 days). Penalties for non-disclosure: -25 reputation + transaction reversal; intentional concealment = permanent ban + criminal referral; board member knowingly voted without recusal = immediate removal + reputation reset to 0.
- Emergency Freeze Protocol (Volume 10 §10.8): AI auto-freeze triggers (Mixtral 8x22B or Llama 3.2 70B, confidence ≥85%): fraud probability >85% (≤2s); unauthorised escrow withdrawal (immediate); law-firm license suspended (within 1h); binding court order (immediate); manager-accountant collusion (within 1h); manager police-clearance invalidated (immediate); emergency board vote 75% (within 2h of vote). Effects: blocks all escrow releases, fundraising, secondary trading, expense approvals, non-emergency votes; allows read-only viewing, emergency board meetings, FRA inspection. Mandatory shareholder vote within 72h on 3 options (continue/replace management/full unwind). Quorum 51%, simple majority of votes cast.
- Shareholder-initiated Independent Review (Volume 10 §10.7): any shareholder may request forensic audit with 1,000 EGP bond (250 EGP for small claims <10,000 EGP). Wrongdoing found → 200% penalty (50% to enterprise, 50% to whistleblower bounty) + -25 reputation (40 for second offence) + manager 30-day suspension + criminal referral if applicable. No wrongdoing → bond forfeited + -5 reputation. Malicious false report → -30 reputation + permanent role restrictions + permanent ban for second offence + civil liability.
- Annual limit: 3 review requests per shareholder per calendar year.
- Whistleblower protection: anonymous channel; identity protected unless court-ordered.

Compliance State Machine:
COMPLIANT → WARNING (late filing, minor discrepancy) → BREACH (non-compliant) → SUSPENDED.
- Quarterly report late >15 days → warning → freeze expenses after 30 days.
- UBO change not filed → flag board → freeze + notify FRA after 14 days.
- Tax filing overdue → warning → escrow freeze after 30 days.
- Sanctions list match → immediate freeze → notify FIU within 24h.
- Social insurance not registered → daily reminder → freeze expenses after 60 days.
- Police clearance expired → remind manager → suspend privileges after 14 days.

8. RISK MANAGEMENT
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Risks Identified + Mitigations:

1. Fraud / Embezzlement:
   - Detection: AI fraud probability ≥85% (Mixtral 8x22B/Llama 3.2 70B); Isolation Forest anomaly detection on treasury events (3 AM approvals, threshold-gaming, first-time large vendors).
   - Mitigation: Emergency Freeze Protocol (≤2s auto-freeze); forensic audit; 200% penalty; criminal referral; manager 30-day suspension; permanent ban for repeat offenders.

2. Conflict of Interest:
   - Detection: Institutional Intelligence Graph (Neo4j) continuous query every 60s; Llama 3.2 confidence scoring.
   - Mitigation: Auto-recusal of conflicted parties; auto-freeze at ≥75% confidence; board/shareholder vote within 7 days; -25 reputation for non-disclosure; permanent ban + criminal referral for intentional concealment.

3. Escrow Breach / Law Firm Failure:
   - Detection: Balance assertion vs ledger every 60s; variance >0.1% = Level 1 flag, >2% = Level 2 flag; GAFI daily license check.
   - Mitigation: 1 primary + 2 standby failover firms per enterprise; automatic failover on license loss/insolvency/fraud; 14-day transition toolkit (data migration package, fund transfer instruction, API handshake, shareholder notification, pre-approved legal opinion).

4. Manager Misconduct:
   - Detection: EVE invoice verification (vendor registration, price check vs CAPMAS market rates, UBO overlap); geotagged milestone photo verification (GPS within 500m, timestamp within 7 days, ViT image classification ≥85% auto-approve); payroll/NOSI verification.
   - Mitigation: Police clearance (Add-on 27) required + 6-month renewal; manager self-dealing auto-rejection (>1% of capital without board approval); board vote to remove (simple majority).

5. Social Insurance Evasion:
   - Detection: NOSI API daily sync; flag employees hired >30/45/60 days without registration.
   - Mitigation: 30-day grace + daily reminders; 45 days = -15 reputation per employee; 60 days = escrow freeze on new expenses.

6. Tax Non-Compliance:
   - Detection: Tax Authority API weekly sync for filing status.
   - Mitigation: Auto VAT/Form 41/withholding filing; warning → escrow freeze after 30 days; -5 reputation per missed filing.

7. AI Hallucination / Bias / Drift:
   - Detection: Independent Gemma 2 7B oversight model; hallucination >90% confidence; bias disparity >20%; drift KL >0.1 (alert), >0.2 (auto-rollback).
   - Mitigation: Daily oversight report to FRA; human-in-the-loop for critical decisions (fraud >85%, emergency freeze, constitutional appeal); model rollback within 5 minutes; >3 overrides in 30 days = suspension pending retraining.

8. Systemic / Contagion Risk:
   - Detection: Monte Carlo 10,000 simulations every 24h (sector downturn, liquidity crunch correlation, fraud contagion by shared law firm/accountant, law-firm failure probability).
   - Mitigation: If platform insolvency probability >1% → increase liquidity reserve contribution to 0.2% for 3 months; contagion mapping flags enterprises sharing failed law firms for enhanced monitoring.

9. Platform Failure / AURIENTA Entity Failure:
   - Detection: Uptime <99% for 7 days; no CRE node reachable for 7 days; AURIENTA bankruptcy/dissolution.
   - Mitigation: Oracle Mirror Survival Protocol (physical hard-copy constitution, emergency board: Independent Accountant + Legal Representative + elected Investor Proxy, paper ballots, reconciliation on return). Code is Apache 2.0 open source; archived with neutral foundation. Escrow funds held by law firms (not AURIENTA). Enterprises may: (A) run own CRE instance, (B) federate to another constitutional infrastructure, (C) continue offline indefinitely.

10. Currency Risk (Cross-Border):
    - Detection: Decentralised FX oracle (Chainlink + Binance + Refinitiv + Central Bank of Egypt, median consensus, outlier exclusion >3σ).
    - Mitigation: Rate locked at reservation click for 48 hours; enterprise fully protected — investor pays locked foreign amount, enterprise receives locked target amount; bridge absorbs difference via forward contracts with partner banks. No crypto settlement; fiat only via regulated banks.

11. Sanctions / AML:
    - Detection: Daily screening against OFAC/EU/UN/local FIU lists; UBO screening for corporate investors; high-risk jurisdiction screening (FATF grey/black list).
    - Mitigation: Immediate freeze on match; notify FIU within 24h; appeal path with evidence.

12. Key Person Risk:
    - Detection: Key Person Risk Engine (Volume 8 §8.10); succession plan status; knowledge transfer %.
    - Mitigation: Visible in Org Chart Generator (red/yellow/green flags); succession panel visible to board + manager; graduation requires "no key person risk, documented succession plans, employee turnover <15%".

13. Threshold Gaming (Split Invoices):
    - Detection: Isolation Forest flags patterns like "10 expenses of 49,000 EGP each just below 50,000 EGP dual-signature threshold".
    - Mitigation: Compliance steward review; manager warning; pattern logged for future detection.

14. Off-Platform Communication Collusion:
    - Detection: When dispute filed, CRE checks whether matter was discussed in Constitutional Chat.
    - Mitigation: Off-platform communication inadmissible as evidence; burden of proof on decision-makers; decisions auto-reversed by CRE within 30 days if no chat record exists.

15. Speculative Flipping (Tier A):
    - Detection: Monthly ownership-change tracking.
    - Mitigation: Tier A monthly cap — no shareholder may change ownership % by >10% per calendar month.

Onboarding Steps (synthesised from KYC, AML, and role-specific requirements):

1. Identity Verification:
   - Government-issued ID (Egyptian National ID for Egyptians; passport for foreigners; Aadhaar + PAN for India).
   - Selfie / liveness video (Class C KYC documents, retained 10 years after closure).
   - Biometric capture — face embeddings + voice prints (Class D, HSM-only, 1 year after closure).
   - For corporate investors: UBO declaration, commercial register, tax ID.

2. KYC / AML:
   - TIN (Tax Identification Number) collection at onboarding for CRS reporting.
   - Source-of-funds declaration for cross-border investments >50,000 EGP.
   - Proof of wealth (bank statements, audited financials) for cross-border enhanced due diligence.
   - Sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UN, local FIU).
   - UBO disclosure (mandatory under AML Law 80/2002 for ≥10% ownership).

3. Consents:
   - Data Privacy Consent (Appendix U — GDPR / Egyptian Data Protection Law 151/2020).
   - AML/UBO Disclosure Form (Appendix T).
   - AI Governance Disclosure & Consent (Appendix O) — consent to AI-enforced decisions.
   - Constitutional Participation Agreement (Appendix S) — binds all Network Participants. Sample clause: "I acknowledge that managers must have valid police clearance and employees must be registered with social insurance (NOSI)."
   - Investor Risk Disclosure (Appendix N) for Capital Partners.
   - Founder Confidentiality & IP Protection (Appendix P) for Founding Operators.
   - Foreign Investor Tax Disclosure (Appendix BB) if applicable.
   - Conflict of Interest Disclosure Statement (Appendix CC) for board members/managers.
   - Family-relationship consent (checkbox) — enables AI-discovered conflict detection; withdrawable anytime (disables only family-based detection).

4. Role-Specific Additional Requirements:
   - Manager: full CV (encrypted, on ledger) + police clearance certificate from Ministry of Interior (or foreign equivalent) + law-firm digital attestation (Add-on 27, valid 6 months, renewable).
   - Board Member / Independent Accountant: professional license, ≥5 years experience, no disciplinary history, professional indemnity insurance (≥5M EGP for legal reps), Big-4 requirement for Tiers C/D/F accountants.
   - Workforce Partner: social-insurance number (NOSI registration by employer within 30 days of hire).
   - Company Owner (Add-on 24): commercial register, tax ID, UBO declaration, authorised signatories (each must have police clearance).
   - Law Firm: FRA corporate license, ≥100M EGP insurance coverage, API readiness (mTLS + Ed25519), AI Expertise Score, bankruptcy-remote clause acceptance.
   - Accounting Firm: ESAA license, no disciplinary history.

5. Template Population Engine (Volume 12 §12.2.2):

   - Populates variables from user/enterprise records.
   - Generates PDF + JSON versions.
   - Sends for digital signature via law-firm notarisation.

### 4.5 Treasury Health Metrics (Vol 16.11)
- LCR = (Escrow balance + receivables) / (Next 30 days expenses). Healthy >1.5 | Warning 1.0–1.5 | Critical <1.0
- CER = Annual revenue / Total capital raised. Healthy >0.5 | Warning 0.25–0.5 | Poor <0.25
- Burn Multiple = Net burn / New revenue added. Healthy <1.5 | Warning 1.5–3 | Poor >3
- Escrow Health Levels: 0 Green (no variance), 1 Yellow (pending reconcile), 2 Orange (health flag, non-essential outlays paused), 3 Red (freeze, all payments halted)

### 5.2 Production Rollout Strategy (Vol 17.18)
- Phase 0 — Internal Canary (Week 1): AURIENTA Stewards + internal testers (20 users), behind feature flag.
- Phase 1 — Pilot Enterprises (Week 2–4): 5–10 pilot enterprises, Tiers A and B only; full functionality + enhanced monitoring; weekly review with pilot founders.

- Phase 3 — General Availability (Week 13+): Open registration; full marketing launch; 24/7 support.
- Rollback plan: identify affected transactions → freeze (read-only mode) → patch in staging/test/deploy → reconcile corrective events → resume. Max downtime target <1 hour.

## 6. GLOSSARY / TERMINOLOGY (Vol 18.27) — every proper noun with definition

- **AURIENTA** — Non-custodial constitutional infrastructure of structural trust; transforms everyday capital into real-economy corporate ownership through digital constitutional rules. (Vol 0, Vol 1)
- **Constitutional Partner** — Any verified individual or entity participating in AURIENTA (Capital Partner, Founding Operator, Workforce Partner, Board Member, etc.). (Vol 1 §1.2, Vol 3)
- **Capital Partner** — A Constitutional Partner who contributes funds to an enterprise in exchange for Equity Units. (Vol 1 §1.2)
- **Founding Operator** — The individual who creates an enterprise on AURIENTA; analogous to founder. (Vol 1 §1.2)
- **Workforce Partner** — An employee of an enterprise who may convert salary into Equity Units. (Vol 1 §1.2)
- **Constitutional Council** — The board of directors of an enterprise, comprising representatives of shareholders, independent accountant, and AURIENTA rep. (Vol 7 §7.3)
- **Equity Unit** — A unit of ownership in an enterprise; equivalent to a share but governed by constitutional rules. (Vol 1 §1.2)
- **Ownership Ledger** — Immutable, append-only record of all Equity Unit ownership and transfers. (Vol 2 §2.5)
- **Constitutional Runtime Engine (CRE)** — Deterministic, fail-secure policy-as-code execution layer that validates every state transition against constitutional rules. (Vol 2)
- **Rego** — Policy language used to write constitutional rules (Open Policy Agent). (Vol 2 §2.2)
- **Decision Token** — Cryptographically signed token issued by the CRE authorising a state transition. (Vol 2 §2.2)
- **Constitutional Escrow Vault** — Bankruptcy-remote escrow account held by a licensed law firm; funds never touch AURIENTA. (Vol 5 §5.2)
- **Zero Custody** — Core principle: AURIENTA never holds, touches, or controls partner funds. (Vol 0 §0.2, Vol 5 §5.1)
- **JOZOUR v3** — Fundamental-only valuation engine (7-step algorithm). (Vol 6)
- **Fundamental Price** — Daily share price derived from EPS × sector P/E × growth + 0.3×NAV. (Vol 6 §6.3)
- **Price Band** — ±5% (normal) or ±10% (exceptional news) limit on secondary market trades around fundamental price. (Vol 6 §6.4)
- **Constitutional Consensus** — Voting process where 1 Equity Unit = 1 vote; quorum 51% of total voting power. (Vol 7 §7.4)
- **Art. 118** — Compliance: Manager removal by General Assembly (shareholders), not board, as per Companies Law 159/1981. (Vol 7 §7.5)
- **Police Clearance** — Certificate from Ministry of Interior verifying no criminal record; required for managers, verified by law firm, valid 6 months. (Vol 12 §12.7)
- **NOSI** — National Organization for Social Insurance; employees must be registered within 30 days of hire. (Vol 8 §8.5, Vol 12 §12.6)
- **GAFI** — General Authority for Investment; provides commercial register, UBO, and incentive data via API. (Vol 12 §12.3)
- **FRA** — Financial Regulatory Authority; oversees capital markets; AURIENTA has no-action letter. (Vol 0 §0.3)
- **Constitutional Health Rating** — Public-facing trust signal (AAA to C) based on governance, financial, operational, compliance, transparency, succession metrics. (Vol 16 §16.7)
- **Vital Signs** — Real-time health metrics: runway, revenue growth, gross margin, employee turnover, vote turnout, dispute frequency, succession coverage, social insurance compliance, police clearance validity. (Vol 16 §16.9)
- **Graduation** — Transition of an enterprise to full sovereign independence, exiting AURIENTA platform. (Vol 15)
- **Maturity Stages** — Four stages: Protected Formation (1) → Structured Growth (2) → Institutional Independence (3) → Sovereign Enterprise (4). (Vol 15 §15.2)
- **Oracle Mirror** — Physical hard copy constitution and emergency governance protocol activated after 7 days of platform downtime. (Vol 12 §14)
- **Anti-Fragility Vault** — Collective reserve funded by 0.5% of each fundraising; provides interest-free loans to enterprises hit by exogenous shocks. (Vol 5 §5.4)
- **Priority Windows** — Secondary market order visibility sequence: Phase 1 exclusive pro rata (48h) → Phase 2 employee/founder (24h) → Phase 3 general market (after 72h). (Vol 9 §9.4)
- **Dynamic Minimum Investment** — Automatically recalculated minimum investment per investor when an investor cap is set; formula: remaining_goal / (remaining_slots × 0.7). (Vol 4 §4.2.6, §4.3.6)
- **Consulting Opt Out** — Shareholder vote (simple majority) to discontinue 2.5% consulting fee after 3 profitable quarters or 2 years of consultancy. (Vol 4 §4.8)
- **Execution Verification Engine (EVE)** — Multimodal AI engine that verifies invoices, milestone evidence, and payroll using OCR, image classification, and LLM reasoning. (Vol 11 §11.2)
- **Institutional Intelligence Graph** — Neo4j graph of all relationships (individuals, enterprises, vendors, UBOs) for conflict detection and systemic risk. (Vol 11 §11.1)
- **Constitutional Appeal Court** — Three-stage appeal process for CRE decisions: AI re-evaluation → human panel → external court. (Vol 10 §10.6)
- **Sovereign Trust Score** — Global reputation score (0–100) based on milestone delivery, budget accuracy, governance compliance, dispute resolution, and longevity. (Vol 3 §3.6)
- **Verifiable Credential (VC)** — W3C standard credential signed by AURIENTA or law firm, proving a role or attribute. (Vol 3 §3.10, Vol 11 §11.7)
- **Regulatory Shadow Mode** — Read-only, anonymised dashboard for FRA providing real-time oversight without PII or execution ability. (Vol 12 §12.4)
- **Company Linking** — Feature allowing a verified individual to link a company they own or represent to their account, enabling multi-entity identity. (Vol 3 §3.2.2)
- **Role Switcher** — UI control allowing a user with multiple roles to act as a specific role for a specific enterprise. (Vol 14 §14.1)
- **Milestone Release** — Release of escrowed funds to enterprise upon verified completion of a predefined milestone. (Vol 5 §5.3)
- **Double Signature** — Expense approval requiring two independent parties (e.g., manager + independent accountant) for amounts 1–10% of capital. (Vol 8 §8.2)
- **Salary to Equity Conversion** — Workforce Partners convert up to 10% of monthly salary into Equity Units at a 15% discount, with 12-month lockup. (Vol 8 §8.3)
- **Liquidity Reserve** — Platform-wide backstop buyer of last resort funded by 0.1% of primary fundraising fees; activated when sell orders exceed buy orders for 5 days. (Vol 9 §9.7)
- **Constitutional Productivity Doctrine** — Principle that governance should accelerate, not hinder, enterprise operations through deterministic rules and AI enforcement. (Vol 1 §1.5)
- **Structural Trust** — Trust derived from constitutional enforcement, cryptographic auditability, and transparency, not from personal relationships. (Vol 1 §1.1.4)
- **Graduation Readiness Score** — 0–100 score computed quarterly; requires ≥90 for graduation vote. Components: governance maturity (30%), financial stability (25%), operational independence (20%), compliance history (15%), platform dependency reduction (10%). (Vol 15 §15.3)
- **Succession Path** — Cryptographic declaration registered by key partners (founder, manager, >10% shareholders) specifying voting proxy, economic beneficiaries, and emergency manager. (Vol 16)
- **Shamir's Secret Sharing** — Used to split succession declaration encryption key among 3 law firm partners, threshold 2 of 3. (Vol 16.1.4)
- **CPP** — Constitutional Percentage Price — price per 1% ownership used in valuation (price bands apply to CPP, not per-share price). (Vol 18.1.2)
- **MoHE** — Ministry of Higher Education (university verification for Tier E).
- **EMA** — Egyptian Meteorological Authority (agriculture module weather data).
- **EEAA** — Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (manufacturing module).
- **ITIDA** — Information Technology Industry Development Agency (tech module).
- **ARC** — Agricultural Research Centre.
- **CAPMAS** — Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (market data).
- **EGX** — Egyptian Exchange (price feeds).
- **CRCICA** — Cairo Regional Centre for International Commercial Arbitration (binding arbitration).
- **DNV / KPMG** — Certified firms for annual penetration testing.
